basic_details.job_title: C.R. College of Education Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One vacant post of Principal (General) is to be filled on a regular basis against a Grant-in-Aid post sanctioned by the Government of Haryana, in the Pay Matrix at Academic Level 14 (₹1,44,200-₹2,18,200) under the 7th CPC, at Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak, run and managed by Jat Education Society (Regd.) Rohtak. Applications are accepted only through the online portal linked on the college website, which is open from 1 November 2026 to 23 November 2026 (till 5:00 PM IST). The hard copy of the application must reach three offices by 5:00 PM IST on 23 November 2026.

qualification.details: Visit the college website, https://crcollegerohtak.com, which carries the link to the online recruitment portal and more details. Submit the application only through the online application portal between 1 November 2026 and 23 November 2026 (till 5:00 PM IST). Pay the non-refundable application fee with the online application: ₹1,000/- for General Category candidates and ₹250/- for SC/BC candidates of Haryana. After successful online submission, download the complete PDF application form. Attach all supporting documents and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer to the hard copy. content_sections.heading: About C.R. College of Education Rohtak
content_sections.text: Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak describes itself as recognised by the NCTE, Haryana Government aided and affiliated to M.D. University, Rohtak. The college is run and managed by Jat Education Society (Regd.), Rohtak-124001 (Haryana), whose President, Gulab Singh, is the President of the college's Governing Body. The Director General Higher Education (DGHE), Haryana granted approval to fill the vacant post of Principal (General) through Memo No. 8/27-2026 C(IV) (1) dated 06/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: the UGC; the National Council for Teacher Education, Delhi; M.D. University, Rohtak; the State Government; and the Director General Higher Education, Haryana, Panchkula.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for C.R. College of Education Rohtak Principal (General)
content_sections.text: Visit the college website, https://crcollegerohtak.com , which carries the link to the online recruitment portal and more details. Submit the application only through the online application portal between 1 November 2026 and 23 November 2026 (till 5:00 PM IST). Pay the non-refundable application fee with the online application: ₹1,000/- for General Category candidates and ₹250/- for SC/BC candidates of Haryana. After successful online submission, download the complete PDF application form. Attach all supporting documents and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer to the hard copy. Send the hard copy separately to each of the three offices below, so that it reaches each office on or before 5:00 PM IST on 23 November 2026. The three offices are: The Director General, Higher Education, Siksha Sadan, Sector-5, Panchkula, Haryana The Dean, College Development Council, M.D. University, Rohtak The Office of the President, Governing Body, Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak An application submitted solely through email, post, courier or by hand, without the online application, will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many Principal posts has C.R. College of Education Rohtak advertised?
faq.answer: The advertisement is for the single vacant post of Principal (General) at Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Principal (General) post?
faq.answer: The online portal closes on 23 November 2026 at 5:00 PM IST, and the hard copies must reach all three offices by the same time.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the C.R. College of Education Principal post?
faq.answer: The qualifications are as per the latest norms of the UGC, NCTE Delhi, M.D. University Rohtak, the State Government and the DGHE Haryana, with reference to the Haryana Affiliated Colleges (Security of Service) Rules, 2006.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Principal (General)?
faq.answer: The post is in the Pay Matrix at Academic Level 14 (₹1,44,200-₹2,18,200) under the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is ₹1,000/- for General Category candidates and ₹250/- for SC/BC candidates of Haryana.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Principal post at Chhotu Ram College of Education?
faq.answer: Apply through the online portal linked on https://crcollegerohtak.com, then send the downloaded PDF form with all supporting documents separately to the DGHE Panchkula, the Dean, College Development Council, M.D. University Rohtak, and the President, Governing Body of the college.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Principal (General) post permanent?
faq.answer: The post is to be filled on a regular basis against a Grant-in-Aid post sanctioned by the Government of Haryana.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply only by post or email?
faq.answer: No, an application submitted solely through email, post, courier or by hand will not be entertained; the online application is compulsory.

faq.question: Q9. Is an NOC required?
faq.answer: Yes, the advertisement states that a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer must be attached.
